name: std::ranges::take_view<V>::take_view

declarations.code: constexpr explicit take_view(V base, ranges::range_difference_t<V> count);

intro:
Constructs a take_view.

1) Default constructor. Value-initializes the underlying view base_ and initializes the count_ to 0. After construction, base() returns a copy of V() and size() returns 0.

2) Initializes the underlying view base_ with std::move(base) and the count_ with count. After construction, base() returns a copy of base and size() returns the smaller of count and ranges::size(base).

base
